locations.name: Valcourt BioLabs
locations.description: Primary crime scene. Dr. Emil Rask was last seen entering the private laboratory on Level 3. Security footage shows he never exited the building.

locations.name: Police Headquarters
locations.description: Central Investigation Department. Case briefing and evidence processing are coordinated from here. Captain Morgan's office is on the 4th floor.

locations.name: Forensics Laboratory
locations.description: City forensics laboratory where the fingerprint analysis and DNA samples for this case are being processed. Dr. Lena Marsh leads the investigation.

locations.name: Rask Residence
locations.description: Home address of Dr. Emil Rask. His personal assistant reported him missing after he failed to return home following the evening shift.

locations.name: Suspect Apartment
locations.description: Apartment of a person of interest identified from the CCTV footage. The individual was seen following Dr. Rask into the building at 21:42. Identity unconfirmed.
